_doc: Things waiting for the user to watch, listen to or decide. The dashboard shows them first, with players. Agents: add an item whenever you need the user's eyes or ears; never ask them to open files in GitHub or chat. Remove (or set status: done) once decided, and record the decision in docs/DECISIONS.md. kind: audio | video | image. files: repo paths.

items.title: Point Roberts A and B, remixed: calmer music, quieter
items.question: You liked A and B. Both now use the calm 'detective' track instead of the marching band, mixed 13 dB under the voice (was 8). Does the music sit right now? Then: which one goes out first (my pick: A for this story)?
files: C: kinetic infographic (old mix, parked as a recipe for other niches)

items.title: Border Quirks music: pick the bed (music only, 45 s each)
items.question: The videos now use 'detective'. If it still feels wrong, pick another, or say 'none' and I will generate new, darker tracks (needs the music model reinstalled, or your laptop's GPU). 'march' is the one you said felt too cheery; it is retired.
files: detective: understated jazz, upright bass, vibraphone (now in use)
spy: muted trumpet, bass clarinet, mischievous
march: the old one, for comparison (retired)

items.title: Action: replace the OpenRouter key (the old one was exposed)
items.question: The key was pasted into the vault file as plain text in a public repo (commit 18a5b52), so treat it as public. 1) openrouter.ai → Keys → delete that key, create a new one. 2) On your laptop: $env:STUDIO_VAULT_KEY = "<vault key>"; "<new key>" | python studio\tools\vault.py set OPENROUTER_API_KEY  3) Upload studio\vault.enc.json to GitHub (studio folder). Never paste a key directly into the file.
